title: MicroRNA-155-5p-dependent upregulation of PDCD4 is involved in oridonin-induced proliferation inhibition of leukemia cells

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《MicroRNA-155-5p-dependent upregulation of PDCD4 is involved in oridonin-induced proliferation inhibition of leukemia cells》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】As the antitumor mechanism of oridonin has not been clearly demonstrated, the effect of programmed cell death protein 4 (PDCD4) regulated by microRNA (miR)-155-5p on the proliferation of leukemia cells after exposure to oridonin was detected.
